## `Canvas`

struct in `choscorui::prelude::Canvas`

```rust
pub struct Canvas { /* private fields */ }
```

Custom drawing: `Canvas::new(|ctx, size| …)` draws with display-list
commands in the space the canvas gets. It fills the space it is
offered; give it a size with `.frame(...)`.

The canvas wraps a `CanvasView`. The closure draws in canvas
coordinates, which start at the top-left corner of the node, and
`size` is the size of the node in points.

#### Examples

```rust
let bars = Canvas::new(|ctx, size| {
    for (index, value) in [0.4, 0.9, 0.6].into_iter().enumerate() {
        let height = size.height * value;
        let x = index as f64 * 24.0;
        let bar = Rect::from_xywh(x, size.height - height, 16.0, height);
        ctx.list.fill_rect(bar, Color::rgb8(0x25, 0x63, 0xeb));
    }
})
.label("Sales by month");
```

Modifiers: every [`ViewExt`](modifiers.md#viewext) method applies to this view.

### Methods

#### `Canvas::label`

```rust
pub fn label(self, label: impl Into<String>) -> Self
```

The name that assistive technology reads for the drawing.

#### `Canvas::new`

```rust
pub fn new(draw: impl Fn(&mut CanvasContext, Size) + 'static) -> Self
```

A canvas that `draw` paints, again after each change that it read.

#### `Canvas::zoomable`

```rust
pub fn zoomable(self, zoomable: bool) -> Self
```

Lets the user pan and zoom the drawing, as `CanvasView` does:

- A drag or the wheel pans. Command with the wheel zooms about the
  pointer.
- The arrow keys pan. `+`, `-`, and `0` zoom about the center.

A zoomable canvas takes focus. The default is `false`.

## `Configured`

struct in `choscorui::prelude::Configured`

```rust
pub struct Configured<C> { /* private fields */ }
```

A control of type `C` as a view. The view builds the control from the
environment, so catalog strings follow the locale; options from
[`Configured::with`](#configuredwith) and [`Configured::with_env`](#configuredwith_env) apply after each
build.

#### Examples

```rust
// `Swatch` is the `CustomControl` of the `ControlView` example.
struct Theme;

impl View for Theme {
    fn body(&self, cx: &mut Cx) -> impl View {
        let dark = cx.state(false);
        Configured::custom(ControlKind::Card, move |_env| {
            Swatch(if dark.get() { Color::BLACK } else { Color::WHITE })
        })
    }
}
```

Modifiers: every [`ViewExt`](modifiers.md#viewext) method applies to this view.

### Methods

#### `Configured::bind`

```rust
pub fn bind<T: Clone + PartialEq + Default + 'static>(self, binding: Binding<T>, to: impl Fn(T) -> ControlValue + 'static, from: impl Fn(&ControlValue) -> Option<T> + 'static) -> Self
```

Connects the control's value to `binding` in both directions. `to`
turns the bound value into the value that the control takes in
[`CustomControl::set_value`](#customcontrolset_value). `from` reads a
`ControlMessage::Changed` value, and returns `None` for a value
of another kind, which leaves the binding as it is. Use it to bind
a control that has no view constructor of its own:

```rust
use choscorui_compose::view::{Binding, Configured};
use choscorui_controls::{ControlKind, ControlValue, Toggle};

fn starred(on: Binding<bool>) -> Configured<Toggle> {
    Configured::custom(ControlKind::Toggle, |_| Toggle::new("Star", false)).bind(
        on,
        ControlValue::Bool,
        |value| match value {
            ControlValue::Bool(on) => Some(*on),
            _ => None,
        },
    )
}
```

## `ControlEvent`

enum in `choscorui::controls::ControlEvent`

```rust
pub enum ControlEvent {
    Pointer(PointerEvent),
    Key(KeyEvent),
    Text(String),
    Gesture(GestureEvent),
    Compose(CompositionEvent),
    Edit(EditCommand),
    FocusChanged(bool),
    Hover(bool),
    Dismiss,
    Timer,
    WindowVisible(bool),
    Shortcut(Shortcut),
}
```

Input delivered to a control.

### Variants

- `Pointer(PointerEvent)`
- `Key(KeyEvent)`
- `Text(String)`: Committed text (typing or IME) while focused.
- `Gesture(GestureEvent)`: A trackpad gesture over the control, such as a pinch. It goes to
  the control under the gesture, then bubbles to its ancestors.
- `Compose(CompositionEvent)`: Input method composition while focused. A control that does not
  use it gets the committed text as `ControlEvent::Text`.
- `Edit(EditCommand)`: An Edit menu command, or its Command-key chord that no control
  used as a key, while focused.
- `FocusChanged(bool)`
- `Hover(bool)`: The pointer entered (`true`) or left (`false`) the node, one of its
  descendants, or its overlay.
- `Dismiss`: A press landed outside the control and its open overlay, or the
  control becomes disabled: close transient popups and emit
  `ControlMessage::Dismissed`. Reply `Stop` when a popup closed, so
  that the host consumes the press.
- `Timer`: The host time reached the control's [`CustomControl::deadline`](#customcontroldeadline).
- `WindowVisible(bool)`: The window became fully hidden (`false`) or visible again
  (`true`). Every control gets it, also a disabled one. A control
  pauses the timers that a person must see, such as a toast's time.
- `Shortcut(Shortcut)`: The user pressed one of the control's
  [`CustomControl::window_shortcuts`](#customcontrolwindow_shortcuts), and the focused control did
  not use the key.

## `ControlView`

struct in `choscorui::prelude::ControlView`

```rust
pub struct ControlView { /* private fields */ }
```

A control mounted as a view. The control keeps its behavior, keyboard
handling, and semantics; the view configures it and connects it to
state.

#### Examples

```rust
/// A square of one color.
struct Swatch(Color);

impl CustomControl for Swatch {
    fn measure(&mut self, cx: &MeasureContext<'_>) -> Measured {
        Measured::new(cx.constraints.constrain(Size::new(24.0, 24.0)))
    }

    fn event(&mut self, _: &mut ControlContext<'_>, _: &ControlEvent) -> EventReply {
        EventReply::Continue
    }

    fn paint(&self, cx: &mut PaintContext<'_>) {
        cx.list.fill_rect(cx.bounds, self.0);
    }

    fn semantics(&self) -> SemanticNode {
        SemanticNode {
            role: SemanticRole::Image,
            name: "Brand color".into(),
            description: String::new(),
            value: None,
            state: Default::default(),
            relations: Vec::new(),
            actions: Vec::new(),
            text: None,
        }
    }
}

let view = ControlView::new(Swatch(Color::rgb8(0x25, 0x63, 0xeb)));
```

Modifiers: every [`ViewExt`](modifiers.md#viewext) method applies to this view.

```rust
pub trait CustomView: CustomControl + 'static { /* items below */ }

The low-level extension point for new controls: a type that measures,

```

```rust

```

Shows `cursor` while the pointer is over `rect`, for a part that a
control paints without [`PaintContext::slot`](#paintcontextslot). A later part over

#### `PaintContext::edge_panel`

```rust
pub fn edge_panel(&mut self, rect: Rect, style: &ResolvedStyle, mirror: bool)
```

Paints the box of a panel at a window edge. A window edge does not
mirror, so the inline sides of `style` resolve left to right in
both layout directions: its border stays on the inner edge. With
`mirror`, they resolve right to left, so a recipe for a left panel
also serves a right panel.

#### `PaintContext::focus_ring`

```rust

```

Paints the theme focus ring just inside `rect` with corner
`radius`, while the node shows keyboard focus. The ring is the one
of a focused `Button` `Root`. It stays inside `rect`, so a control
that rings its whole bounds is not clipped.

the start corner radius of the style. Use it for a ring that the
clip of the control or a neighbouring part would cut.

#### `PaintContext::rtl`

```rust
pub fn rtl(self, rtl: bool) -> Self
```

Sets the right-to-left layout direction.

#### `PaintContext::slot`

```rust
pub fn slot(&mut self, rect: Rect, style: &ResolvedStyle, content: impl FnOnce(&mut PaintContext, Rect))
```

Paints a slot box like `paint_slot`, then calls `content` with
a context for the box inside the padding.

#### `PaintContext::state`

```rust
pub fn state(self, state: VisualState) -> Self
```

Sets the hover, focus, and disabled flags of the node.

#### `PaintContext::strings`

```rust
pub fn strings(self, strings: &'a Localizer) -> Self
```

Sets the messages of the window locale.

#### `PaintContext::style`

```rust
pub fn style(&self, query: StyleQuery) -> ResolvedStyle
```

The resolved style of `query`, from the cache. While the host eases
a state change of the node, the colors, ring, shadows, opacity, and
offset are part of the way from the earlier style.

#### `PaintContext::time`

```rust
pub fn time(self, time: f64) -> Self
```

Sets the time in seconds for running animations.
